description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Snow (Ice)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Snow (Ice)
description.text: Increases [Ice Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Snow (Ice) after using two Ice abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Froststrike+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Snow (Ice)
description.text: Four single attacks (0.60 each), 100% hit rate, damages the user for 25% max HP,  grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
